`final class KeyState`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.input.key` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [KeyState.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/input/key/KeyState.java)

Remembers which key each held place of the keyboard typed, so that a release and a held test use the key of its press.

## Description

The UI bridge registry keeps one `KeyState`: a press records its place and its key, and the release of that place reports the same key, even when the layout changed in between.
[`Key.isDown`](/reference/input/key/#Key-method-isDown) reads it.

## Method details

<a id="KeyState-method-press"></a>

### press

`void press(Key physicalKey, Key key)` 

Records that the place `physicalKey` went down and typed `key`.

<a id="KeyState-method-release"></a>

### release

`Key release(Key physicalKey)` 

Forgets a place that went up and returns the key that its press typed, or the place itself when no press was recorded.

<a id="KeyState-method-isDown"></a>

### isDown

`boolean isDown(Key key)` 

If `true`, a key is held.
For a key that depends on the layout, it tests every held place that typed it; for any other key, it asks the window bridge.

<a id="KeyState-method-getKey"></a>

### getKey

`Key getKey(Key physicalKey)` 

Returns the key that a held place typed, or the place itself when it is not held.
